scope: Positive-inertance fixed-density pipes with finite node thermal inventories, upwind sensible-enthalpy transport, temperature-dependent resistance and explicit friction heat recovery
friction_heat_deposition: Declared recovered fraction, equally split between endpoint node inventories; remainder exported
energy_accounting: Independent mechanical, thermal and total ledgers; pressure work counted once, recovered friction is internal exchange
approximation: Lumped momentum without advective kinetic-energy transport or pressure waves
